Welcome to AniPixels!

Battle, capture, and collect AniPixels—pixel-styled anime fighters from across multiple anime worlds! ⚔️🎮

• Defeat AniPixels in combat to capture them
• Build the ultimate team with unique strengths
• Travel through different anime worlds, each with their own characters and themes
• Unlock special abilities on certain AniPixels that can turn the tide of battle
• Progress, collect, and become the strongest trainer across dimensions
• 700+ AniPixels to collect!
